changelog:
🚀 What's New in OffPay v3.0 (Build 1) :
• 🌟 Apple HIG & Apple Music Design Overhaul: Sleek Obsidian Glassmorphic cards, AMOLED dark mode, and iOS San Francisco typography.
• 🎵 Floating Glassmorphic Pill Nav Bar: 4 clean executive tabs (Home, Radar, Trusted, Menu) with coral active highlights.
• 🛠️ 'Other Options' Glass Sheet: 3x3 modal menu for Send, Receive, QR Generator, Scan QR, Security, Profile, Appearance, Diagnostics & Logs.
• 🖥️ Full-Screen Secondary Views: Clutter-free screens with dedicated AppBar back-button navigation.
• 🛡️ Zero-Net Defender & Sequence Chaining: Cryptographic hash chaining and AES-GCM-256 to prevent replay attacks.
• 📡 Offline BLE Radar & Hybrid Pay: Direct offline Bluetooth transactions with smart MAC fallback naming.
• 📊 Real-Time Security Logs & Diagnostics: Live hash verification, system health audits, and exportable logs.
• 🔓 Secret 10-Tap NFC Developer Mode gesture & updated team credits.
